hooks.name: Render test for new component
hooks.description: When a new component is created in src/components, generate a basic vitest render test for it.

action.prompt: A component was just created. Add <Name>.test.tsx next to it using only vitest and react-dom/server (renderToString); jsdom and Testing Library are not installed, so add no dependencies. One test: it renders non-empty HTML without throwing. Run `npm test` in haunted-notes and fix only your new test if it fails.
